description: MCP server and connector that clones the OpenCode workbench installation onto Linux machines — locally or over SSH — reproducing the OpenCode config, MCP servers, agent skills, plugins and Docker tooling. Exposes 6 tools over stdio.
rules: Run locally with `npx -y github:simonplmak-cloud/opencode-workbench` (Node stdio MCP server; no API key).
Drive a clone with the tool order `workbench_info` → `inspect_target` → `plan_clone` → `apply_clone` → `verify_clone`; use `install_component` to install a single component by id.
Every tool takes a `target` of `{mode: "local"}` or `{mode: "ssh", host, user, port?, identityFile?}`.
The connector never reads, transmits or writes secret values; `apply_clone` writes an empty `~/.env.workbench` template (mode 600) listing the `{env:VAR}` names to fill in.
`apply_clone` is idempotent; pass `dryRun: true` to preview the plan without making changes.
